Site.title: Site
Site.description: A campus waste disposal, bin, or drop-off location.

name.description: Name or landmark for the disposal site.

category.description: Waste stream category accepted at this site.

notes.description: Access guidance, timing, or rules for this site.

authorId.description: Anonymous user ID of the creator.

confirmationCount.description: Number of unique anonymous user confirmations.

reportCount.description: Number of problem reports submitted for this site.

status.description: Status of the site: active or hidden (hidden if 3+ reports).

SiteConfirmation.title: SiteConfirmation
SiteConfirmation.description: A confirmation by an anonymous user verifying that a site exists and is accurate.

userId.description: ID of the user confirming the site.

SiteReport.title: SiteReport
SiteReport.description: A problem report by an anonymous user for an invalid, missing, or overflowing site.

userId.description: ID of the user reporting the site.

reason.description: Reason for the report (e.g. missing, overflowing, wrong category).

CommunityFeedback.title: CommunityFeedback
CommunityFeedback.description: Anonymous waste sorting correction with item name and category only (no photos or personal data).

itemName.description: Name of the corrected waste item.

/sites/{siteId}.description: Collection of crowdsourced and campus disposal sites.

/sites/{siteId}/confirmations/{confirmat.description: Confirmations per site, keyed by siteId_userId to enforce 1 confirmation per user.

/sites/{siteId}/reports/{reportId}.description: Problem reports per site, keyed by siteId_userId to enforce 1 report per user.

/feedbacks/{feedbackId}.description: Anonymous corrections storing item name + category only.
